memory_reason: N512 normal membership replay uses 12389104 KiB native RSS. Eightfold volume gives 94.5 GiB; the repeated-state probe adds 24 GiB of saved particle bits at N1024. The 192 GiB request also covers transient arrays and batch page cache. Fixed-density diagnostics need a separate measured 288 GiB allocation.
packing: Nine native replays run sequentially with at most 64 threads; streaming membership checks use one CPU. Shared allocation leaves the other 64 cores and remaining node memory schedulable.
scope: Membership identity and host geometry at z2,1,0; old/new catalogues on identical snapshots; ordinary 64/32-thread comparison and two-call bitwise particle-state restoration at z0. Normal density differences are recorded and interpreted alongside the separate fixed-field control.
